question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Spacios **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Spacios **= **Spacious** means having a lot of space; large in size. (बहुत जगह होना; आकार में बड़ा)

 
 
• Example - *The hotel rooms are **spacious **and comfortable.*
 
 

Therefore, except for option 1, the rest of the options are correctly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lyre **means an ancient musical instrument consisting of a U-shaped frame with strings attached to it. (एक प्राचीन वाद्य यंत्र जिसमें एक यू-आकार का फ्रेम होता है, जिसमें तार लगे होते हैं)
 
• **Irrespective **means regardless or in spite, and it is almost always followed by the word "of." (परवाह किए बिना या बावजूद)
 
• **Soluble **means that will dissolve in liquid. (तरल पदार्थ में घुल जाने वाला; घुलनशील, विलेय)
